content.comment_body: Hello, I need to measure vacuum in the range -1 to 0 bar with two decimal places. When I input these values into the analog amplifier, I get an error saying the measurement range set by gain/offset is invalid. What steps can I take to resolve this?
What sensor type are you using with the amplifier? Is it a 4-20 mA sensor?

From your description, it sounds like you need to scale the standard input range (usually 0 to 1000) to -1 to 0 with two decimals. You can do this by setting: Gain = 0.10, Offset = -100, Decimal points = 2.
If your analog input signal is 4-20 mA, you could connect two analog amplifiers in series as an option.
Thanks, this setup worked during simulation. I will try it once I receive the 4-20 mA sensor and the AM2 module.

Suggestions include properly configuring scaling parameters and considering hardware options, with the user confirming success in simulation and waiting for hardware to proceed.
